title: Multicultural Tea Party3｜Social Intelligence Laboratory, Ritsumeikan University

summary.lead: A multicultural tea party was held at the Social Intelligence Lab!

overview: We held a multicultural tea party in our laboratory on 4/17. It was a festive tea party with a variety of sweets brought by international students. We got nervous the sweets we were eating for the first time and enjoyed talking about their impressions of the tastes and smells of the sweets. This was the third time the multicultural tea party. We will continue to hold this event!
